title: The Blue-G Interactive Vector Archive 77-97
summary: Explore the rich vector arcade 'history' of Blue-G Interactive in this enhanced collection of 11 games. The custom engine provides a unique visual style and is made to run fast even on low spec hardware! Watch your step.
about:
11 Full Arcade Experiences - Experience a wide variety of titles in this collection exploring the rich vector arcade 'history' of Blue-G Interactive, coming this June to PC, Mac, and Linux. 

Additional Titles

And great news, even more titles that couldn't make the launch lineup are being 'restored' as we speak!  Any additional titles will be added as free updates to the base game, it always bums me out to stumble on a new  game and then being overloaded with DLC options.  Don't need to worry about that here, will always just be the one base game to buy!

Make Your Own Content!

The tools to make all of the art assets and tracks are included in the base game: build custom tracks, decorations, and vehicles.  Make your boat a gigantic cactus if you're feeling like it! 
(Note: Creation tools are not currently gamepad ready and will require mouse/keyboard.  Will be looking to improve the gamepad experience with these but isn't a top priority and this part probably won't be controller-friendly by release.)

Multiplayer, Cheat Codes, Unlockables, and Visual Settings

Classic multiplayer action! - Several titles in the collection include a wide variety of multiplayer action including split screen, shared view, and turn based games.

Cheat Codes? Who needs cheat codes?! - Not you, but you're getting them anyways!  Unlock various cheats, gameplay settings, and more for every game in the collection as you play!  Or you could always cheat to unlock the cheats...

Customize the Visuals! - Includes a wide variety of settings to fine tune everything from classic arcade bloom, to unstable laser 'dancing', to per game bezels, and more!  

Stats, Stats, Stats

Every wonder just how many lasers you've fired off into the void, the distance you've driven, or how many conflicts you've resolved via the art of mini-golf? Well wonder no more!  Every game features unnecessarily granular stat tracking that you can view at any time.

Steam Deck Tested

Steam Deck Tested - And ESPECIALLY OLED Deck Ready for that screen!

All games were tested thoroughly on a Steam Deck during development, even used one for a large portion of the local multiplayer testing. 

Runs great on every level of Deck with the OLED edition REALLY bringing out the absolute best in the visuals with that screen.

Not JUST deck ready, runs on just about everything

The Blue-G Vector Archive runs on a lightweight custom C++ engine meaning there will be versions available for PC, Mac, and Linux/Steam Deck!  Tested on a wide variety of hardware as far back as a 2011 Mac Mini running Linux and runs at playable frame rates in all cases so far. 
 

(And yes all the 'history' is just a for-fun flavor angle for the project. Figured I should make that 100% clear!)
